name: Push-up
instructions: Plank position, hands under shoulders.
Lower chest near floor, press back up.

name: Incline push-up
instructions: Hands on a bench or sturdy surface above floor.
Lower chest, press up — easier than floor push-ups.

name: Decline push-up
instructions: Feet elevated on bench, hands on floor.
Lower chest under control, press to lockout.

name: Diamond push-up
instructions: Hands together under chest, thumbs touching.
Lower with elbows tracking back, press up.

name: Archer push-up
instructions: Wide hand placement, shift weight to one side.
Lower toward the bent arm, press up. Alternate.

name: Barbell bench press
instructions: Lie on bench, eyes under bar, grip slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower to mid-chest, press to lockout.

name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Sit with dumbbells on thighs, kick back to flat bench position.
Press from chest level to lockout, control on the way down.

name: Incline barbell bench
instructions: Bench at ~30 degrees.
Lower bar to upper chest, press to lockout.

name: Incline dumbbell press
instructions: Bench at 30 degrees, dumbbells at shoulders.
Press to lockout, lower with control.

name: Dumbbell fly
instructions: Lie on bench, dumbbells over chest, slight bend in elbows.
Lower in a wide arc, squeeze chest to bring back together.

name: Cable fly
instructions: Stand between cable stacks, slight forward lean.
Sweep handles together in front of chest, control return.

name: Chest dip
instructions: Lean torso forward on parallel bars.
Lower until shoulders below elbows, press up.

name: Dumbbell floor press
instructions: Lie on floor, dumbbells over chest.
Lower until upper arms touch floor, press up.

name: TRX chest press
instructions: Face away from anchor, hands in straps, body straight.
Lower chest between hands, press back to plank.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders.
Pull chest toward bar, lower under control.

name: Chin-up
instructions: Underhand grip, shoulder width.
Pull chest to bar, full hang at the bottom.

name: Negative pull-up
instructions: Jump or step up to top of pull-up.
Lower under control over 3-5 seconds.

name: Inverted row
instructions: Hang under a sturdy bar or table edge, body straight.
Pull chest to bar, lower under control.

name: Barbell row
instructions: Hinge to ~45 degrees, neutral spine.
Pull bar to lower chest, control the descent.

name: Single-arm dumbbell row
instructions: Brace knee + hand on bench, dumbbell in opposite hand.
Pull elbow to hip, squeeze, lower with control.

name: Pendlay row
instructions: Bar on floor, torso parallel to ground.
Explosive pull to lower chest, reset on floor each rep.

name: Seated cable row
instructions: Sit tall, knees soft, handle in both hands.
Pull to lower abs, squeeze shoulder blades, control return.

name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Set knee pad, grip wider than shoulders.
Pull bar to upper chest, drive elbows down, resist on the way up.

name: Face pull
instructions: Rope at face height, elbows high.
Pull rope to face, externally rotating at the top.

name: Band pull-apart
instructions: Band at chest height, arms extended.
Pull band apart until arms are wide, control return.

name: Dumbbell shrug
instructions: Stand tall, dumbbells at sides.
Lift shoulders straight up, hold, lower under control.

name: Barbell shrug
instructions: Bar in front of thighs, overhand grip.
Lift shoulders to ears, hold briefly, lower.

name: Conventional deadlift
instructions: Bar over midfoot, hands just outside knees.
Brace, push the floor away, lock out hips and knees together.

name: Dumbbell deadlift
instructions: Dumbbells in front of thighs.
Hinge to mid-shin, drive hips forward to stand.

name: Romanian deadlift
instructions: Soft knees, hinge at hips.
Lower bar along thighs to mid-shin, drive hips forward.

name: Dumbbell RDL
instructions: Soft knees, dumbbells along thighs.
Hinge until hamstrings stretch, return to standing.

name: TRX row
instructions: Lean back under straps, body straight.
Pull chest to handles, control on descent.

name: Standing overhead press
instructions: Bar at shoulders, elbows under wrists.
Brace and press overhead, head through at lockout.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Sit upright, dumbbells at shoulders.
Press overhead, lower to start.

name: Arnold press
instructions: Start with palms facing you at shoulders.
Press up while rotating palms forward; reverse on descent.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
instructions: Stand tall, slight forward lean, soft elbows.
Raise dumbbells to shoulder height, lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell front raise
instructions: Dumbbells at thighs.
Raise straight in front to shoulder height, lower with control.

name: Rear delt fly
instructions: Hinge forward, dumbbells hanging.
Raise arms wide, squeezing shoulder blades.

name: Cable lateral raise
instructions: Stand side-on to low pulley, handle in far hand.
Raise to shoulder height, control return.

name: Band lateral raise
instructions: Stand on band, handles in hands at sides.
Raise to shoulder height, slow return.

name: Pike push-up
instructions: Downward-dog position, head between hands.
Lower head toward floor, press up.

name: Handstand push-up
instructions: Wall handstand, hands shoulder-width.
Lower head to floor, press to lockout.

name: Dumbbell upright row
instructions: Dumbbells in front of thighs.
Lift to chest level, elbows leading. Lower slowly.

name: Machine shoulder press
instructions: Adjust seat so handles are at shoulder height.
Press to lockout, lower under control.

name: Dumbbell biceps curl
instructions: Stand tall, elbows pinned to sides.
Curl to shoulder, supinate at top, lower with control.

name: Hammer curl
instructions: Neutral grip (palms facing each other).
Curl up keeping palms facing in, lower slowly.

name: EZ-bar curl
instructions: Shoulder-width grip on EZ-bar.
Curl to chest, lower under control.

name: Preacher curl
instructions: Arms locked over preacher pad.
Curl to chest, slow eccentric to full extension.

name: Concentration curl
instructions: Seated, elbow braced on inner thigh.
Curl with full range, squeeze at top.

name: Cable curl
instructions: Low pulley, EZ or straight bar.
Curl up, control the negative against the cable.

name: Band curl
instructions: Stand on band, handles in hands.
Curl to shoulders, resist on the descent.

name: Triceps dip
instructions: Upright torso on parallel bars.
Lower until elbows at 90 degrees, press up.

name: Bench dip
instructions: Hands on bench behind you, legs extended.
Lower hips toward floor, press back up.

name: Overhead triceps extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead, elbows narrow.
Lower behind head, extend back to lockout.

name: Triceps kickback
instructions: Hinge forward, upper arm parallel to torso.
Extend at elbow until arm is straight, control return.

name: Cable triceps pushdown
instructions: Elbows pinned to sides, push handle down to lockout.
Return slowly to chest level.

name: Skullcrusher
instructions: Lying, EZ-bar over chest, elbows fixed.
Lower bar toward forehead, press to lockout.

name: Close-grip bench press
instructions: Shoulder-width grip on bar.
Lower with elbows close to ribs, press to lockout.

name: Band triceps pushdown
instructions: Anchor band overhead.
Press handle down, control on the way up.

name: Bodyweight squat
instructions: Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Squat to comfortable depth, drive through midfoot to stand.

name: Jump squat
instructions: Drop into a quarter squat.
Explode up into a jump, land softly into the next rep.

name: Pistol squat
instructions: Single-leg squat, free leg held in front.
Lower under control, press up keeping heel grounded.

name: Back squat
instructions: Bar on upper traps, feet shoulder-width.
Squat to parallel or below, drive through midfoot.

name: Front squat
instructions: Bar racked on front delts, elbows high.
Squat upright, drive up keeping torso vertical.

name: Dumbbell goblet squat
instructions: Hold dumbbell at chest.
Squat with chest tall, knees tracking toes.

name: Kettlebell goblet squat
instructions: Hold kettlebell horns at chest.
Squat upright, drive elbows between knees at depth.

name: Bulgarian split squat
instructions: Rear foot on bench, dumbbells at sides.
Lower front knee, drive up through front heel.

name: Walking lunge
instructions: Step forward into a lunge, knee tracking toe.
Push off front foot, alternate legs.

name: Dumbbell lunge
instructions: Dumbbells at sides, step forward into lunge.
Drive through front heel to stand. Alternate.

name: Box step-up
instructions: Place foot fully on box.
Drive through heel to stand on top, step down with control.

name: Box jump
instructions: Quarter squat, swing arms, jump onto box.
Stand tall on top, step down (don't jump down).

name: Leg press
instructions: Feet shoulder-width on platform.
Lower until knees ~90 degrees, press without locking out hard.

name: Leg extension
instructions: Adjust pad to top of ankle.
Extend legs to lockout, lower slowly.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat.
Drive hips up to lockout, squeeze glutes, lower.

name: Banded glute bridge
instructions: Loop band around thighs, knees pushed out.
Bridge to lockout, hold, lower under control.

name: Hip thrust
instructions: Upper back on bench, bar over hips with pad.
Drive hips up, squeeze glutes, lower with control.

name: Single-leg RDL
instructions: One foot, dumbbell in opposite hand.
Hinge forward keeping back leg straight, return to standing.

name: Good morning
instructions: Bar on upper back, soft knees.
Hinge forward to ~parallel, drive hips back to standing.

name: Kettlebell swing
instructions: Hinge to start, kettlebell between knees.
Snap hips forward to swing to chest height; let it fall back.

name: Kettlebell clean & press
instructions: Clean kettlebell to rack position.
Press to overhead lockout, return to rack, then to floor.

name: Turkish get-up
instructions: Lying with kettlebell pressed up.
Stand up keeping arm vertical, then reverse the movement.

name: Hamstring curl
instructions: Adjust pad above ankles.
Curl heels toward glutes, control return.

name: Gym ball hamstring curl
instructions: Lie on back, heels on ball, hips up.
Curl ball toward glutes, extend back out.

name: Standing calf raise
instructions: Stand on a step or floor.
Press up onto balls of feet, lower under stretch.

name: Dumbbell calf raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides.
Raise onto balls of feet, hold briefly, lower.

name: Seated calf raise
instructions: Pad on quads just above knees.
Press up onto balls of feet, lower with control.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms under shoulders.
Body straight, glutes squeezed, breathe.

name: Side plank
instructions: Forearm under shoulder, body in a line.
Hold; switch sides.

name: Plank shoulder taps
instructions: High plank, hips square.
Tap each shoulder without rocking the hips.

name: Dead bug
instructions: On back, arms up, knees over hips.
Lower opposite arm + leg, return, alternate.

name: Bird dog
instructions: Hands and knees, neutral spine.
Extend opposite arm + leg, hold briefly, switch.

name: Crunch
instructions: Knees bent, hands at temples.
Curl shoulders off floor, lower under control.

name: Bicycle crunch
instructions: On back, hands behind head.
Bring opposite elbow to knee, alternate in a pedalling motion.

name: V-up
instructions: Lie flat, arms overhead.
Simultaneously lift arms and legs to meet, lower with control.

name: Mountain climber
instructions: High plank, hips level.
Drive knees alternately toward chest at a steady pace.

name: Hanging knee raise
instructions: Hang from a bar, shoulders engaged.
Curl knees toward chest, lower without swinging.

name: Hanging leg raise
instructions: Hang from bar, legs straight.
Lift legs to horizontal or higher, lower with control.

name: Ab wheel rollout
instructions: Kneeling, ab wheel under shoulders.
Roll out keeping back flat, pull back to start.

name: Russian twist
instructions: Seated, lean back, feet off floor optional.
Rotate ball side to side, controlled.

name: Pallof press
instructions: Side-on to cable, handle at sternum.
Press out, resist rotation, return slowly.

name: Banded Pallof press
instructions: Anchor band, side-on, hands at sternum.
Press out, hold, return.

name: Gym ball jackknife
instructions: Plank with shins on ball.
Tuck knees toward chest, extend back out.

name: Gym ball pike
instructions: Plank with shins on ball.
Hike hips up into a pike, return slowly.

name: Jump rope
instructions: Soft knees, light bounce.
Wrist rotation drives the rope.

name: Jump rope intervals
instructions: 30 s fast, 30 s easy, repeat.
Mix in double-unders or alternating feet.

name: Easy run
instructions: Conversational pace.
Land midfoot, relax shoulders.

name: Run intervals
instructions: Warm up 5 minutes.
Alternate 1 minute fast / 2 minutes easy for 6-8 sets.

name: Burpee
instructions: Squat, hands down, jump back to plank.
Push-up optional, jump feet in, jump up with arms overhead.

name: Treadmill run
instructions: Set easy pace, slight incline (1%).
Maintain steady effort for the duration.

name: Incline walk
instructions: Set incline 8-12%, brisk walking pace.
Avoid holding rails; let arms swing.

name: Stationary bike
instructions: Adjust seat to slight knee bend at bottom.
Steady cadence, moderate effort.

name: Bike intervals
instructions: Warm up 5 min.
30 s hard / 90 s easy, 6-10 rounds.

name: Rowing
instructions: Drive with legs first.
Lean back slightly, pull handle to ribs. Return: arms, body, legs.

name: Rowing intervals
instructions: Warm up 500 m easy.
250 m hard / 250 m easy, 6-8 rounds.

name: TRX pike
instructions: Plank with feet in TRX straps.
Pike hips up to inverted V, return slowly.
